setup: Run ./make-fixtures.sh <dir>, copy <dir>/<fixture> and <dir>/snapshot.sh to a fresh location, and run each eval from <fixture>/work with the ship-task plugin loaded and gh signed in. The fixture origin is a local bare repo, so gh repo view fails there; the skill must still stop for the reason under test and never push or merge. Check the 'untouched' assertions with: (cd <fixture> && ../snapshot.sh) | diff - <fixture>.before. These cover the starting-state check only; PR creation, template filling, checks and merging need a real GitHub repo and are not covered here.

evals.name: on-base-dirty
evals.expected_output: Stops before doing anything: the current branch is the default branch (and the tree is dirty).
assertions: Snapshot is identical to on-base-dirty.before (nothing pushed, committed or stashed)
Reports that the current branch is the default branch, or that there are uncommitted changes
Did not run git push, gh pr create or gh pr merge
Did not create a branch or commit to move the work somewhere shippable

evals.name: detached-head
assertions: Did not run git push, gh pr create or gh pr merge

evals.name: nothing-to-ship
evals.expected_output: Stops: the branch has no commits ahead of origin/main.
assertions: Reports that there is nothing to ship (no commits ahead of the base)
Did not run git push, gh pr create or gh pr merge

evals.name: feature-dirty
evals.expected_output: Stops: uncommitted changes on the feature branch.
assertions: Snapshot is identical to feature-dirty.before (the uncommitted edit to x.txt is still there, not committed or stashed)
Did not run git push, gh pr create or gh pr merge
